info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Partnerships API
info.description: The Corporate Partnerships API facilitates the retrieval of detailed information about corporate partnerships within the banking sector. This endpoint allows users to access data related to established partnerships, enhancing relationship management and strategic planning efforts for financial organizations. Typical consumers include bank administrators and business analysts who seek insights on partnership dynamics and opportunities. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their partnership inquiries and drive collaborative finance initiatives.

get.description: This endpoint retrieves a list of all corporate partnerships within the corporate relations framework, providing essential data for analysis and decision making.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the details related to corporate partnerships under corporate relations. It should provide the necessary input for the query to retrieve the appropriate partnership data based on the defined schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of corporate partnerships.
